compose_gtn_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs using gtn.compose to chain their input-output mappings
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a graph using gtn.forward_score to get log-sum-exp over all paths
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring path through a graph using gtn.viterbi_path and gtn.viterbi_score
union_gtn_graphs: compute the union of multiple graphs using gtn.union to combine their languages into one graph
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a graph using gtn.remove to eliminate silent arcs
